mapper.select: SELECT visual_beat_id AS visualBeatId, media_type AS mediaType, storage_mode AS storageMode, source_duration_ms AS sourceDurationMs, fit_mode AS fitMode, trim_start_ms AS trimStartMs FROM project_render_input_beats WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY global_start_ms, scene_index, beat_index, visual_beat_id
